meta.note: Auto-generated from the KYP workbook's free-text knowledge columns, not from an LLM read -- a Python script split each sheet's notes into per-item blocks using blank-line and heading heuristics. Each item carries: item_name, subcategory (if resolvable), aliases (scraped from 'also known as' / 'also called' phrasing), required_attributes (raw 'Ask ...' sentences, unvalidated and not yet split into individual fields), and the full original notes lines as a fallback. 'in_short_taxonomy_list' + 'match_confidence' show whether the item was cross-referenced against the sheet's short taxonomy table. 'listed_only_no_notes' are taxonomy-listed items with no matching notes block -- real catalog gaps, not parsing misses. Items with an empty notes array, and any item_name that reads oddly, are worth a manual look before this drives production extraction/matching -- treat this as a strong first draft of category_attributes + item aliases, not a finished schema.
